bio_en: Shavro (Mkrtich Misakian) was a native of Kars, educated at the Gevorgian seminary, from which he was expelled for 'rebelliousness', and then at the Nersisian school in Tiflis. He worked as a village clerk in the Kars region and took part in circles working for the Armenian cause. Wanting a more decisive role, he crossed into Ottoman Armenia on transport work, leaving a testament to his small son Hakob dated Tabriz, 24 January 1904. On the way he was murdered by his two Kurdish guides, who robbed him and threw his body into the water.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Obituary written by Malkhas (Hairenik 30 July 1904).
